newsitem.title: USA: NYPA sees Fitzpatrick nuke fully back by next week.
newsitem.headline: NYPA sees Fitzpatrick nuke fully back by next week.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Thursday its 832 megawatt (MW) James A Fitzpatrick nuclear power station would resume full output early next week after returning to service today.
In a statement, the utility said, "The plant is expected to return to full power production following completion of scheduled tests over the next several days."
The Scriba, N.Y., facility was shut last Sunday while in restart mode when a leak was detected in the electrical hydraulic control system that regulates steam flow to its turbine.
Fitzpatrick was originally idled for a 47-day refueling and maintenance program.
NYPA produces about a fourth of New York state's electricity.
